1.title: ‘She’s One of Us’: Mary Peltola’s Bumpy Rise to Political Power
1.summary: Ms. Peltola, the Democratic Senate candidate in Alaska, has complicated politics: She is pro-gun, pro-oil and pro-gas — but also pro-environment and especially pro-fish.

2.title: A ‘Big Problem’: Trump’s War With Iran Drags Down Republicans in Midterms
2.summary: As their November picture darkens, and gas and diesel prices soar, some Republicans who backed the war for months are now changing their tune.

3.title: White House Claim of Finding $250 Billion in Fraud Uses Questionable Numbers
3.summary: The ledger used by a task force created by President Trump is difficult to verify and includes cases that were identified and went to trial during the Biden administration.

4.title: UK Deploys Bomb Squad Near R.A.F. Fairford, Air Base Used by US
4.summary: British police said they had arrested several men on suspicion of offenses under the Explosives Act and had evacuated local residents near the R.A.F. Fairford base.

5.title: Two mass shootings in South Africa leave 27 dead
5.summary: The two attacks hours apart come as the country struggles to stop high levels of gang-related armed violence.

6.title: The Raffles’ Singapore Sling Costs $40. There’s a Reason Tourists Still Love It.
6.summary: You can still buy a Singapore Sling in the colonial-era hotel where it’s said to have been invented more than a century ago. Custom versions have arisen nearby.
